title: Factorization formula for the canonical coordinate sheaf isomorphism
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M,N quasi-coherent O_Y-modules [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], U an affine open, MA,NA modules over Gamma(Y,U) with specified section equivalences sM,sN, P a projective resolution of MA, and K,F K-flat cochain complexes with quasi-isomorphisms q:K -> M[0], s:F -> N[0] [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For n in N, the canonical coordinate sheaf isomorphism is the composite of the chart tensor-homology isomorphism, the chart K-flat comparison isomorphism, and inverse normalized restriction-homology isomorphism. This is equality of the specified isomorphisms, not just existence.

source.place: Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor calculation; Tag 08DV, associated sheaf of a K-flat complex; Tag 06YT, comparison using a common K-flat resolution; Tag 01I9, functorial associated-sheaf pullback. Attach the chartwise comparison already stated in QCohOrdinaryTensorResolutionCoordinatesFamily.

proof.text: Unfold tensorResolutionCoordinateSheafIso. Its defining expression is exactly the displayed composite of three isomorphisms; reflexivity proves the equation.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorResolutionCoordinateSheafIso_factors
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (MA NA : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sM : MA ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))
    (sN : NA ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] N.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution MA) (K F : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M)
    (s : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) K)
    (hF : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) F)
    (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (n : ℕ) :
    tensorResolutionCoordinateSheafIso Y M N U MA NA sM sN P K F q s hK hF hq hs n =
      (tensorResolutionChartHomologyIso N U MA NA sN P n ≪≫
        tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N U MA sM P K F q s hK hF hq hs (-(n : ℤ)) ≪≫
        (tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso U.2.fromSpec K
          ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N) (-(n : ℤ))).symm)
